notes.title: Oblivion Eagle v1.0.3
notes.notes:
-Zweihander Onis' attacks are less aggressive
-Spear Onis' red spear attacks are less aggressive
-Fixed bug that affects gaining Skill Upgrade Points properly
-Fixed bug where Rey crashes the game during a cutscene
-Fixed bug where the Dark Guardian crashes the game when hit by Setup Bomb
-Fixed minor visual errors

notes.title: Oblivion Eagle v1.0.2
notes.notes:
-Lethal Wipe no longer adds time to enemies' attack timers; now sets them between 3.33 and 5 seconds
-Fixed bug where Euno's bullets despawn as soon as they appear
-Using Lethal Wipe on Iudex during the Banish Mode tutorial now ends the tutorial and continues the fight
-Fixed minor visual errors

notes.title: Oblivion Eagle v1.0.1
notes.notes:
-Guard Onis now run away 1.67 seconds after all nearby enemies are defeated
-Fixed bug where Terminal Valos takes double damage from Lethal Wipe
-Reduced time that Lethal Wipe stuns enemies from 5 seconds to 3.33 seconds
-Fixed minor visual errors

notes.title: Oblivion Eagle's opening movie has been added!
notes.notes:
After months of hard work and sweat (and love... duh), [i][b]Oblivion Eagle's[/b][/i] opening movie is finally here! It's currently available in the demo, but it will be in the full game as well.

This opening would not have been possible without [i]Leandro Bastos[/i], the man behind the vocals for the opening theme, "[u]Life is Yours (ft. Leandro Bastos)[/u]." If you're interested in using his incredible services, don't hesitate to reach out to him on Fiverr by clicking [url=https://www.fiverr.com/leandro_bastos]here[/url]!

If you'd like to watch the opening movie, [u]download the demo[/u] and check it out! If not, you could view it by clicking below, too... but it just [i]feels[/i] better to see it in-game, you know? Doctors agree!

notes.title: Oblivion Eagle is launching on August 9, 2023!
notes.notes:
The wait is finally over! [i][b]Oblivion Eagle[/b][/i]'s launch is confirmed to be [u]August 9, 2023[/u]! Get your favorite mouse ready, because this grand light-gun adventure is coming in hot!

Thank you to the many people who have played [i][b]Oblivion Eagle's[/b][/i] demo! If you thought the demo was intense, wait until you see what these [i]new areas and bosses[/i] have to offer!
